name: Bold Custom Pricing
summary: Shopify wholesale and B2B pricing app by Bold: separate prices for tagged customer groups, VIP and member tiers, quantity breaks and tiered pricing on one storefront, without Shopify Plus.
best_for: Shopify stores that want to sell wholesale, B2B or VIP prices from their existing storefront without Shopify Plus, with quantity breaks and one or a few customer groups
skip_if: you cannot afford wrong prices at checkout during setup and have no staging theme to test on; you need more than one price list on a $29 budget; or you sell wholesale through Shopify POS and do not want the $129 plan
honest_knock: Bold Custom Pricing has no free plan and charges by customer group: a second price list already takes you from $29 to $69 a month, and bulk CSV pricing and the Shopify POS integration sit only on Complete at $129. The reviews are split more sharply than the 4.4 suggests, with 58 of 538 at one star. The recent complaints are specific: price syncing that broke and 'wreaked havoc' (October 2026, fixed by support), crashes for three weeks with no answer from support (June 2026), incorrect pricing that cost more than the app (February 2026), a slower store and order numbers disturbed while support removed the app (February 2026), and ten days of changing cart quantities and wrong prices after migrating to the new version (April 2025). We have not run the app ourselves; this dossier is read from the listing and its reviews.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essential · per month, pricing for 1 customer group
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-06 on the Shopify App Store listing at apps.shopify.com/customer-pricing, where the app is titled Custom Pricing: Wholesale B2B; prices in USD) Three plans, each with a 14-day free trial, and the ladder is built on how many customer groups can see their own prices. Essential is $29 a month for 1 customer group, with storewide or product and variant discounts, unlimited quantity breaks, a customisable quantity-break grid, tax controls and manual customer tagging. Standard is $69 a month for up to 10 customer groups and adds automatic tagging by country or purchase history with an automatic email when a customer is tagged. Complete is $129 a month for unlimited customer groups and adds advanced pricing rules, bulk CSV price import and export, the Shopify POS integration, premier support, expert setup and a service level agreement. There is no free plan. All charges are billed in USD, and recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days.

compare_with.name: Wholesale Gorilla
compare_with.why: Wholesale Gorilla is in our dossiers too. Read on 19 September 2026, it costs $34.95, $69.95 or $149.95 a month with a 21-day trial and no free plan, and it does not meter customer price groups: pricing rules and groups are unlimited on all three tiers, so you climb for features rather than volume. Bold Custom Pricing does the reverse and sells groups: 1 for $29, 10 for $69, unlimited for $129. A store with a single trade tier pays less on Bold; a store with several trade tiers on a small budget gets more groups for its money on Wholesale Gorilla's $34.95 Lite, provided its features cover the rest. Bold's own case is its wider family of apps (Memberships, Bundles, Discounts, Multi-Currency) and a launch in 2013.
